english.title: Drive mechanically propelled vehicle with out sufficient/reliable brakes/power to ensure min speed in a Mersey tunnel
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), drove a mechanically propelled vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..),

(A)_[within the Mersey Tunnels, namely **(..SPECIFY THE TUNNEL..),]_
(B)_[within the Mersey Tunnel approaches and marshalling areas, namely **(..SPECIFY THE TUNNEL APPROACH OR MARSHALLING AREA..),]_

when the vehicle was not provided with

(C)_[sufficient and reliable brakes]_
(D)_[such mechanical power as ensured its maintaining the minimum speed specified in the Mersey Tunnels Byelaws 2003 in relation to the lane in which it was moving]_
english.legislation: Contrary to Byelaws 3(r) and 16 of the Mersey Tunnels Byelaws 2003.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
drove a mechanically propelled vehicle
within the Mersey Tunnels/ Tunnel approaches / marshalling areas
when it was not provided with sufficient and reliable brakes OR
such mechanical power as ensured its maintaining
the minimum speed specified in the Mersey Tunnels Byelaws 2003
in relation to the lane in which it was moving
